name: Soft wall dinks over a low line
summary: Alone at a wall, keep a soft rally of dinks just above a net-height line and count unforced errors per 50 shots.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 0.9 m above the floor (the net) and stand about 2 m from the wall
Rally soft dinks off one bounce: the ball should hit the wall just above the line and drop, not pop up
An error is a ball below the line, a ball you pop above head height, a mis-hit, or a ball you had time to reach but missed
Sets of 50 shots; restart the rally after an error
success_criterion: In a set of 50 dinks, at most 5 errors
safety_notes: Soft pace only: no speed-ups or drives at this distance from the wall. Keep the ball below head height. Stop if your wrist or back hurts.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Many unforced errors come in the soft game; a low, repeatable dink with margin over the net cuts them (AN-04), and counting errors per 50 shots makes the rate visible with no partner or court. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
